name: WdLigatures
description: Specifies the type of ligatures applied to a font.

constants.name: wdLigaturesNone
constants.description: Does not apply any ligatures to the font.

constants.name: wdLigaturesStandard
constants.description: Applies standard ligatures to the font. Standard ligatures are designed to enhance readability. Standard ligatures in Latin languages include "fi", "fl", and "ff", for example.

constants.name: wdLigaturesContextual
constants.description: Applies contextual ligatures to the font. Contextual ligatures are often designed to enhance readability, but may also be solely ornamental. Contextual ligatures may also be contextual alternates.

constants.name: wdLigaturesHistorical
constants.description: Applies historical ligatures to the font. Historical ligatures are similar to standard ligatures in that they were originally intended to improve the readability of the font, but may look archaic to the modern reader.

constants.name: wdLigaturesDiscretional
constants.description: Applies discretional ligatures to the font. Discretional ligatures are most often designed to be ornamental at the discretion of the type developer.

constants.name: wdLigaturesStandardContextual
constants.description: Applies standard and contextual ligatures to the font.

constants.name: wdLigaturesStandardHistorical
constants.description: Applies standard and historical ligatures to the font.

constants.name: wdLigaturesContextualHistorical
constants.description: Applies contextual and historical ligatures to the font.

constants.name: wdLigaturesStandardDiscretional
constants.description: Applies standard and discretional ligatures to the font.

constants.name: wdLigaturesContextualDiscretional
constants.description: Applies contextual and discretional ligatures to the font.

constants.name: wdLigaturesHistoricalDiscretional
constants.description: Applies historical and discretional ligatures to the font.

constants.name: wdLigaturesStandardContextualHistorical
constants.description: Applies standard, contextual, and historical ligatures to the font.

constants.name: wdLigaturesStandardContextualDiscretional
constants.description: Applies standard, contextual and discretional ligatures to the font.

constants.name: wdLigaturesStandardHistoricalDiscretional
constants.description: Applies standard historical and discretional ligatures to the font.

constants.name: wdLigaturesContextualHistoricalDiscretional
constants.description: Applies contextual, historical, and discretional ligatures to a font.

constants.name: wdLigaturesAll
constants.description: Applies all types of ligatures to the font.
